headline: NBA 2K25 is being delisted after just 2 years
script: NBA 2K25 is getting delisted, just two years after launch. 2K will pull it from digital stores on October 30th. Then on January 1st, 2027, the servers shut down. That means multiplayer is gone, and so is MyCareer, the single player story mode, because it needs the servers to run. You also can't earn virtual currency anymore. If you buy before October 30th, you can still download it and play the offline modes. Two years. That's all you get.
